574-5671-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating either a 0/1 green Plant creature token or a 2/2 black Zombie creature token depending on how many uniquely named lands you control
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-5671-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

443-4210-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
443-4210-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple, Magus of the Bridge and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Wayward Disciple triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2577-5670-5931.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-5931.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

4311-5078-6791-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

34-141-413.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
34-141-413.description:
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Footsteps of the Goryo.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Footsteps of the Goryo
Resolve the Footsteps of the Goryo copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

4381-4694-6797-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
4381-4694-6797-7306.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing it to become a Spirit artifact creature in addition to its other types until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

728-2033-3249-5173.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-5173.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

4247-4316-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4247-4316-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1170-1594-5131-5330--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1594-5131-5330--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Helm of Awakening.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

413-618-4681.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kiki-Jiki, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Kiki-Jiki enters, Blasting Station triggers. Resolve both triggers from this step and step 4, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

855-2021-2060-4565.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

2232-7827-7830-7833.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7830-7833.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

64-1987-6573.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
64-1987-6573.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
64-1987-6573.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-1987-6573.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1619-2921-4605-5542-6154.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6154.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning White Plume Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing White Plume Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the White Plume Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of White Plume Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2921-4605-5542-6154.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1887-2034-5189-7426.easyPrerequisites: There are two removable +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.
1887-2034-5189-7426.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Saproling, putting two +1/+1 counters on Berta due to Vorinclex.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1824-2530-2932-6747.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
1824-2530-2932-6747.description:
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Bontu's Monument triggers, causing you to gain life and each opponent to lose life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat.

240-647-2921-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat from step 2.

2060-4893-5140-7267.description:
Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2060-4893-5140-7267.notes:
You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

3996-4050-6753.description:
Activate Twilight Drover by paying {2}{W} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Spirits, adding {2}{W}.
When the Spirits die, Twilight Drover triggers three times, putting three +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat.

176-2438-6705.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-2438-6705.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Quina.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5226-6972-7155.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Arcbound Fiend.
When Arcbound Fiend dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Fiend's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Fiend from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

4681-5170-5933-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

575-5231-7084.notablePrerequisites: You control two other nontoken creatures that have base power 1 or greater.
575-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the first additional creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the second creature.
When the second creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the second creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the first creature.
Activate the first and second creature by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the first creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, returning the first creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, earthbending the second creature.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the second creature.
When the creature dies, Yedora and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yedora trigger, doing nothing.
Repeat from step 5.

3490-4210-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4210-5231-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Pious Evangel or Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain life and target opponent to lose 1 life if Wayward Disciple triggered.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1846-3525-7014.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Pemmin's Aura attached to North Pole Patrol.
North Pole Patrol does not have summoning sickness.
1846-3525-7014.description:
Cast High Tide by paying {U}.
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
High Tide triggers, adding {U}.
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Repeat from step 2

1358-1978-4851.description:
Animate Timeless Lotus using Sydri.
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

4629-4826-6712.description:
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Sonic triggers for each creature you control with haste or flash that is dealt damage, creating that many untapped Treasure tokens due to Archelos.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.
4629-4826-6712.notes: It is strongly recommended to perform this combo once you have the highest life total to end the game. It is, however, not a requirement.

2060-2919-3042-3525.description:
Activate Resplendent Mentor by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Resplendent Mentor.
Repeat.

2034-2811-4593-6705.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the creature tokens die, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.
2034-2811-4593-6705.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

2921-3781-4215--124.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nontoken green Insect.
When the Insect dies, Zask and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Zask trigger, putting the Insect on the bottom of your library from your graveyard and causing you to mill two cards.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for that Insect and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.
2921-3781-4215--124.notes: Eventually the combo will stop in step 3, as the Insect will be milled into your graveyard. Note that you must control another nontoken green Insect besides Zask.

304-478-804-2821-6745.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four artifacts. Uthros has twelve or more charge counters on it
304-478-804-2821-6745.description:
Animate Candelabra using Tough Cookie.
Cast Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2}{U}{U}. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Candelabra of Tawnos that is still named Sakashima the Impostor and legendary.
Activate Uthros, Titanic Godcore by paying {U} and tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}
Activate Sakashima the Impostor by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Minamo and Uthros, Titanic Godcore.
Activate Minamo's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat from step 3.

1086-1274-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1086-1274-3490-4659.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

2921-6188-6591--85.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
2921-6188-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Fear of Missing Out as attackers.
Fear of Missing Out's second ability triggers, untapping Squall and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat each combat phase.

695-813-3617.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Time Walk and Settle Beyond Reality.
695-813-3617.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk and Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

1789-4875-5256-5649.notablePrerequisites: Conspiracy on the battlefield with "Dragon" chosen.
1789-4875-5256-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters the battlefield, Lathliss triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Lathliss trigger, creating a 5/5 Dragon creature token.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, Bladewing's Thrall triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-2872-5970-6219.notablePrerequisites:
Ritual Chamber is locked.
Marina and Clever Conjurer do not have summoning sickness.
1636-2872-5970-6219.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Ritual Chamber.
Ritual Chamber triggers, creating a 6/6 Demon creature token with flying.
When the Demon enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Ritual Chamber.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

864-957-1987-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
864-957-1987-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Eternal Witness.
When Eternal Witness and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Stretch from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Stretch during your draw step.
Repeat.

1636-5231-6095.notablePrerequisites:
You have a Zombie creature card in your graveyard.
Creatures you control can tap to produce enough mana to cast the Zombie in your graveyard minus at most {R}.
Zul Ashur does not have summoning sickness.
1636-5231-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting a Zombie card in your graveyard.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding enough mana to cast the Zombie.
Cast the Zombie from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {R}.
Repeat.

813-2781-4617-4906-6084.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You have not activated Soulbright Flamekin's ability more than twice this turn.
813-2781-4617-4906-6084.description:
Activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Felidar Guardian's trigger, targeting each other creature you control except Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the copies of Felidar Guardian's trigger targeting Soulbright Flamekin and Scholar of the Ages, blinking Soulbright Flamekin and Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Deflecting Swat and up to one other instant or sorcery from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate Soulbright Flamekin by paying {2}, targeting Agrus Kos.
Agrus Kos triggers, causing you to pay {1}{R/W} to copy Soulbright Flamekin's ability targeting each other creature you control.
Resolve all Soulbright Flamekin triggers, giving the targeted creatures trample until end of turn and adding eight {R}.
Cast Deflecting Swat by paying {0}, changing any of the remaining Felidar Guardian triggers not targeting Agrus Kos to target Agrus Kos instead.
Repeat from step 6.

1528-1636-5219-5231.notablePrerequisites: Dual Casting attached to a creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
1528-1636-5219-5231.description:
Cast Caberetti Charm by paying {R}{G}{W}.
Holding priority, activate the creature with Dual Casting attached by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Cabaretti Charm.
Resolve the copy of Cabaretti Charm, creating two 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
When the Citizen tokens enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers twice, untapping all creatures.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Citizen, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of creature tokens, you may instead choose any of Cabaretti Charm's modes to deal infinite damage to any creature(s) and planeswalker(s) and/or get infinitely large creatures until end of turn.

1127-1812-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Spirits.
1127-1812-2440.description:
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
When Blinking Spirit enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {W}.
Repeat.
If you control six or more Spirits, this combo nets infinite mana.

uses.n: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle

1401-1644-2051-4377.manaNeeded: {7}{G}{G}{G}{U}{U} each turn plus enough mana to pay for commander tax the first turn, if applicable
1401-1644-2051-4377.notablePrerequisites: You control at least eight lands, three of which are Islands.
1401-1644-2051-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U} and sacrificing three Islands, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and return Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning the three Islands from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Journey to the Oracle either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
Resolve Journey to the Oracle, putting the three Islands from your hand onto the battlefield and returning Journey to the Oracle to your hand.
The Islands enter the battlefield, triggering Tatyova three times.
Resolve the first Tatyova trigger, causing you to gain 1 life, mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the remaining Tatyova triggers, causing you to gain two life and draw two cards.
Repeat each turn.

228-1722-2034-5158.notablePrerequisites: Skullclamp attached to another creature you control.
228-1722-2034-5158.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Skullclamp attached, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Skullclamp, causing you to draw two cards.
Nadir Kraken triggers twice, causing you to pay {2} to put two +1/+1 counters on Nadir Kraken and create two 1/1 Tentacle creature tokens.
